notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Etrata does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls at least three nontoken creatures.
description:
Cast Echoing Equation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing each other creature you control to become a nonlegendary copy of Etrata.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Etrata and two other creatures you control.
Etrata and the two creatures trigger.
Resolve the first Etrata trigger, exiling a nontoken creature the opponent controls with a hit counter on it, and shuffle Etrata into your library.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Resolve the last Etrata trigger, exiling a nontoken creature the opponent controls with a hit counter on it, shuffle Etrata into your library, and cause the opponent to lose the game.
